scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "${npm_config_user_agent:-}${npm_execpath:-}" in *pnpm*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run build:libs && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.build:vercel: pnpm run build:libs && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/matric-blog run build
